name: pc-build-advisor
title_zh: 装机单先查散热余量再谈性价比的配置顾问
tagline_zh: 不套模板，逐件核对机箱尺寸、供电接口和升级路径。你报预算和用途，它追问到能落地为止，连旧件值不值得留都帮你算清楚。
tagline_en: No templates. It cross-checks case size, PSU cables, and upgrade paths. Give it budget and use case, it digs.
desc_en: Avalia, compara, revisa e monta configurações de PC com foco em preço, performance, espaço físico, compatibilidade, térmica e valor real de upgrade. Usa investigação adaptativa em vez de questionário fixo.
why_zh: 用自适应追问替代固定问卷，每步都基于你上一轮回答调整方向。比跑分更看重物理兼容性和真实升级收益。
why_en: Adaptive probing instead of a fixed quiz. It weighs physical fit and real upgrade value over raw scores, and will veto a hyped.
limit_zh: 只覆盖台式机整机配置，不涉及外设、显示器、笔记本。需要你懂基本硬件名词（如PCIe、ATX），纯小白会被追问卡住。
limit_en: Desktop towers only—no laptops, monitors, or peripherals. You must know terms like PCIe and ATX. No purchase links, just the build plan.
title_en: PC builder that checks cooling and clearance before price
